vb_textbox.text: I couldnt identify a specific different between the different gnomes or which side of the screen they appeared on in relation to higher value mushroom win. However one side would be consistantly a bit higher than the other, this changes randomly after a few goes.best i could do was use the x1 multiplier to take turns swapping between the 2 different sides(villages) as less is at stake here, then once decided which was best make sure u choose that side for a while whilst the x5 multiplier is in play. if it feels like your winnings have dropped - try swapping across to the other side again.
